mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking.inquiry_record (id, channel, shipper_company_id, tracking_number, inquirer_kind, inquirer_user_id, received_at, escalated, case_number, recorded_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{channel}, #{shipperCompanyId}, #{trackingNumber}, #{inquirerKind}, #{inquirerUserId}, #{receivedAt}, #{escalated}, #{caseNumber}, #{recordedBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracking.inquiry_record WHERE channel = 'WEB_SELF' AND escalated = FALSE AND received_at >= #{from} AND received_at < #{to}
